# CORE829

> CORE829 SRL is a technology agency based in Roman, Romania, delivering custom servers, B2B automations, web design, web applications, desktop software, SEO and 360° digital marketing to clients across Europe and the Americas. CORE829 Servers is CORE829's dedicated hardware department: it designs, sources and manages custom server builds (AI, rendering, storage, gaming, hosting) built with Intel and NVIDIA components, without manufacturing hardware directly.

CORE829 does not resell off-the-shelf products: every engagement starts from a client request, is designed by CORE829's team, produced through vetted partners, and verified before delivery. The company ships hardware worldwide except where restricted by its Advanced IC Certification.

## Services

- [B2B Automations](https://core829.net/en/servizi/automations): automation of repetitive processes across CRM, ERP, email and invoicing tools.
- [Web Design](https://core829.net/en/servizi/webdesign): custom interface and site design driven by brand identity, performance and conversion.
- [Web Apps](https://core829.net/en/servizi/webapp): full-stack custom web applications, B2B/B2C platforms and vertical CRMs.
- [Executable Software](https://core829.net/en/servizi/desktop): dedicated desktop software for vertical business needs.
- [SEO Indexing](https://core829.net/en/servizi/seo): technical and content optimisation for organic visibility.
- [360° Marketing](https://core829.net/en/servizi/marketing): organic social media, content strategy and paid advertising on Meta Ads and Google Ads.
